name: ai-investment-advisor
description: AI 投资顾问 — 带 Agent Loop 的自托管投资分析应用（Docker 部署 / Windows、macOS 本地调试）

scripts.build: npm run build -w @aia/shared && npm run build -w @aia/server && npm run build -w @aia/web
scripts.build:server: npm run build -w @aia/shared && npm run build -w @aia/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @aia/shared && npm run typecheck -w @aia/shared && npm run typecheck -w @aia/server && npm run typecheck -w @aia/web
scripts.test: npm run build:server && npm run test -w @aia/server && npm run test -w @aia/web
scripts.preview:financials: npm run build:server && node node_modules/rollup/dist/bin/rollup -c packages/web/rollup.preview.config.mjs && node packages/web/dist-test/preview-financials.js
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run check:deploy && npm run probe:sources && npm run smoke
